step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential amplifier with a cross-coupled NMOS pair providing negative resistance for gain boosting. The tail transistors act as switches to turn the amplifier on and off, making it suitable for switched-opamp based delta-sigma modulators.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 10.7-MHz Fourth-Order Bandpass Modulators Using Two Switched Opamps

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for the opamp (modulator DR is 62dB)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_in * (R_load || R_neg). The cross-coupled pair provides negative resistance (-2/gm) that partially cancels the positive output resistance, significantly boosting the DC gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Single-stage pseudo-differential amplifiers typically achieve 20-30dB, but the negative resistance enhancement can push this to 40-60dB depending on exact bias matching.

paper_reported.value: Modulator operates at 10.7 MHz IF with 7.13 MHz clock

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm_in / (2 * pi * C_load). With gm ~ 1.3mA/V and C_load = 1pF, UGF ~ 200MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support a 10.7 MHz signal and 7.13 MHz clock with double sampling, the opamp needs a bandwidth significantly higher than the clock rate to settle accurately.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the dominant pole at the output nodes and non-dominant poles at the internal cascode/switch nodes.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single-stage topology with a 1pF load capacitor typically exhibits a dominant pole response, ensuring good phase margin (>60 degrees).

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the opamp

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = I_total * VDD. I_total ~ 2 * I_pmos = 2 * 450uA = 0.9mA. Power = 0.9mA * 1.8V = 1.62mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for 1.8V supply in SKY130. The single opamp consumes a fraction of the total 8.45mW reported for the entire 4th-order modulator.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, AC gain, UGF, phase margin, and transient response of the switched opamp. Clocks are tied high to keep the opamp in the ON state for AC characterization.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched Opamp Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N4 N5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N6 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N5 LABEL_NET_0 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 LABEL_NET_1 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 N4 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Clocks (tied high to keep opamp ON for AC analysis)
VN0 N0 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 1.8

* Bias for cross-coupled tail
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

* AC inputs (Differential)
V_INP LABEL_NET_0 0 dc 0.9 ac 0.5
V_INN LABEL_NET_1 0 dc 0.9 ac -0.5

* Load capacitors
C1 N4 0 1p
C2 N5 0 1p

* Differential to single-ended converter for easy measurement
E_diff out_diff 0 N4 N5 1

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N4) v(N5)

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 1u
meas tran vout_max max v(N4)
meas tran vout_min min v(N4)

quit
.endc
.end
